sourceAnchors.message: Avoid catching RuntimeException in try-catch block
sourceAnchors.reason: SS3434-5 strict nonsecret YAML/path configuration boundary deliberately emits one value-free invalid-configuration error for rejected parser/input values; no assembly/business/DB failure is handled here and no success is returned by this clause. BUG2791 fatal cause/suppressed/cycle graph is preserved before the fixed catalog. Independent malformed/null/structure/path/URL vectors assert fixed failure; raw YAML, cause and suppressed values never enter diagnostics.

sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact executor is owned by the whole Test and enclosed in an unconditional finally shutdownNow then asserted awaitTermination10s; each of32 jobs is get5s bounded. Explicit finite close is used instead of Java25 ExecutorService.close whose wait is unbounded. Every task only parses literals and returns a hash; failed join/get fails the Test and is never counted as success.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: The exact J2EE-container thread restriction does not govern this standalone JUnit parser concurrency fixture. A private eight-worker pool runs32 immutable literal jobs, futureget5s and unconditional shutdownNow/await10s asserted; no app server, native process, backend, shared authority or external side effect. Identical independently fixed canonical result and worker termination are both required.
